description: Infraestructura y acceso a saneamiento mejorado is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Instituto de Vivienda de la Ciudad (IVC). Vivir en un hábitat adecuado implica tener acceso a instalaciones apropiadas. Esta dimensión incluye indicadores de calidad de conexión a servicios básicos, acceso a agua potable, acceso a saneamiento mejorado, combustible utilizado para cocinar, acceso a red eléctrica. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Instituto de Vivienda de la Ciudad (IVC). It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
